_about: One-off caption corrections for Reels already published on the YardSwaps Facebook Page. Run the 'Fix published captions' workflow (caption-fixes.yml). An entry is applied only while its 'find' text is still in the live description, so a re-run does nothing. Instagram does not allow editing a published caption through the API, so Instagram posts can't be listed here.
